Auth._comment: Group whose members may sign in (web UI and management API, every auth scheme). Blank = the box's local administrators: BUILTIN\Administrators on Windows; root, sudo, wheel or admin on Linux. Windows domain groups must be qualified ('CONTOSO\Certificate Admins'); a bare name only matches local groups. Linux example: 'certadmins'.

Plugins._comment: Script plugins (installer.script, validation.dns-01.script) run operator-supplied commands as the service account. Set false on hosts that don't need them.

Coverage._comment: Optional AD CS CA to inventory for the console's estate view, as 'host\CA name'. The service account needs read access to the CA database.

Verification._comment: Post-install TLS check of the endpoints each installer reports. Attempts x (ConnectTimeoutSeconds + RetryDelaySeconds) bounds one endpoint; BudgetSeconds bounds the whole step.

Notifications._comment: Optional webhook (HTTP POST, JSON body) for renewal failure/recovery alerts. FailureThreshold = consecutive failures before the first alert; repeated every multiple.
